answer: Pick 5 percent of submissions at random and have three peers from different subnetworks re-execute them. A mismatch halves the submitter's credit and halves the credit of every peer that attested it, so a ring cannot protect itself by voting together. At 5 percent sampling a 200-clone farm sees about 10 re-executions per epoch and loses half its credit each time. A raven that echoes its own work fails on the first divergent run, and a ledge of colluding peers is diluted to zero by the quorum rule.
